snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.6 - Lockers + Softlock Prevention!
snippet.description:
With Chris's Classroom's biggest update coming soon, a few smaller updates are being pushed to ensure peak gameplay!

↓↓↓ Update V1.6 Log ↓↓↓

- Added lockers to all gamemodes! The player can hide behind lockers in an attempt to lose Chris.
- Added a softlock prevention measure to ensure Theodore does not softlock the player
- Updated UI elements across all gamemodes

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in game are created by me!
